verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Sentry ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP and offers a Trace Explorer for span samples and attributes. Nothing documents navigating from a span to its correlated logs or metrics, so these are adjacent capabilities rather than the cross-signal correlation the story requires. Metrics correlation is not mentioned at all.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end
